+package com.tpov.schoolquiz.android.feature.quizzes_screen.presentation.fake
+
+import com.arkivanov.decompose.Child
+import com.arkivanov.decompose.router.stack.ChildStack
+import com.arkivanov.decompose.value.MutableValue
+import com.arkivanov.decompose.value.Value
+import com.tpov.schoolquiz.android.feature.quizzes_screen.presentation.component.QuizzesChild
+import com.tpov.schoolquiz.android.feature.quizzes_screen.presentation.component.QuizzesComponent
+import com.tpov.schoolquiz.android.feature.quizzes_screen.presentation.config.QuizzesConfig
+import com.tpov.schoolquiz.android.feature.quizzes_screen.presentation.uistate.QuestListUiState
+import com.tpov.schoolquiz.shared.core.catalog.domain.model.CatalogId
+import com.tpov.schoolquiz.shared.feature.quest.domain.model.QuestId
+
+class FakeQuizzesComponent : QuizzesComponent {
+
+    private val _childStack = MutableValue(idleStack())
+    override val childStack: Value<ChildStack<QuizzesConfig, QuizzesChild>> get() = _childStack
+
+    var lastPoppedLevel: Int? = null
+
+    fun setQuestListActive(catalogId: String = "cat-1", catalogName: String = "Математика") {
+        val config = QuizzesConfig.QuestList(catalogId, listOf(catalogName))
+        val fakeQuestList = FakeQuestListComponent(QuestListUiState.Loading, listOf(catalogName))
+        _childStack.value = ChildStack(
+            active = Child.Created(configuration = config, instance = QuizzesChild.QuestList(fakeQuestList)),
+            backStack = emptyList(),
+        )
+    }
+
+    override fun popToLevel(uiLevel: Int) {
+        lastPoppedLevel = uiLevel
+    }
+
+    override fun openQuestList(catalogId: CatalogId, catalogName: String) {
+        setQuestListActive(catalogId.value, catalogName)
+    }
+
+    override fun openSectionList(questId: QuestId, titles: List<String>) = Unit
+
+    override fun dismissQuizzes() {
+        _childStack.value = idleStack()
+    }
+
+    private fun idleStack(): ChildStack<QuizzesConfig, QuizzesChild> = ChildStack(
+        active = Child.Created(configuration = QuizzesConfig.Idle, instance = QuizzesChild.Idle),
+        backStack = emptyList(),
+    )
+}

Это **string-based**, НЕ percent-based — нет Float precision issues.

docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7114:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:605:## ADR-LR-15 — Lesson rating fields naming и типы
docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7115:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:608:**Context**: Spec `0-spec.md §34` использует `ratingCount: Int?` (nullable). Quest precedent: `Quest.averageRating: Float?`, `Quest.averageRatingCount: Int` (non-nullable). Inconsistency требует resolve.
docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7117:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:612:- `Lesson.ratingCount: Int = 0` — **non-nullable**, default 0
docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7119:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:615:**Rationale**: (1) Consistency с `Quest.averageRatingCount: Int` (`shared/feature/quest/domain/.../model/Quest.kt:62,69`). (2) `ratingCount` всегда имеет смысловой default 0. Nullable Int требовал бы везде null-check без смысловой ценности. (3) `top3` empty list — natural default (нет участников). (4) Firebase backward compat: missing field defaults via DTO `@SerialName` + Kotlin defaults.
docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7120:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:617:**LessonEntity column**: `ratingCount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` — `@ColumnInfo(defaultValue = "0")`.
docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7121:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:620:- `ratingCount: Int?` — создаёт null-check noise в presentation. Spec nullable — опечатка vs user intent "нет оценок = 0". Отклонено.
docs/features/lesson-runner/_codex-review/cross-phase/codex-output-round2.md:7122:docs/features/lesson-runner/03-decisions.md:624:Если Cloud Function записывает `ratingCount: null` в Firestore (например баг CF) — DTO mapper должен иметь `?: 0` default для `ratingCount`; без этого `LessonEntity.ratingCount NOT NULL` вызовет crash при десериализации. Митигация: DTO mapper добавляет `ratingCount = dto.ratingCount ?: 0` (defensive default). Если `averageRating: Float?` становится non-nullable позже — breaking change только в DTO/presentation layer, domain модель остаётся совместимой.

    33	@Composable
    34	fun FillBlankContent(
    35	    state: QuestionUiState.FillBlank,
    36	    candidates: List<OptionUi>,
    37	    onCandidateSelected: (candidateId: String) -> Unit,
    38	    onBlankCleared: (blankIndex: Int) -> Unit,
    39	    onSubmit: () -> Unit,
    40	    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    41	) {
    42	    val usedTexts = state.filledValues.values.toSet()
    43	
    44	    Column(
    45	        modifier =
    46	            modifier
    47	                .fillMaxWidth()
    48	                .padding(16.dp),
    49	        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
    50	    ) {
    51	        if (state.hasImage && state.imageUrl != null) {
    52	            QuestionImage(url = state.imageUrl, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
    53	        }
    54	        FlowRow(
    55	            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
    56	            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
    57	        ) {
    58	            state.templateParts.forEach { part ->
    59	                when (part) {
    60	                    is TemplatePart.Text -> {
    61	                        Text(
    62	                            text = part.content,
    63	                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
    64	                        )
    65	                    }
    66	                    is TemplatePart.Blank -> {
    67	                        val filledText = state.filledValues[part.index]
    68	                        Button(
    69	                            onClick = { if (filledText != null) onBlankCleared(part.index) },
    70	                            colors =
    71	                                if (filledText != null) {
    72	                                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
    73	                                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer,
    74	                                        contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
    75	                                    )
    76	                                } else {
    77	                                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
    78	                                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
    79	                                        contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
    80	                                    )
    81	                                },
    82	                        ) {
    83	                            Text(text = filledText ?: "___")
    84	                        }
    85	                    }
    86	                }
    87	            }
    88	        }
    89	        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
    90	        if (candidates.isNotEmpty()) {
    91	            LazyVerticalGrid(
    92	                columns = GridCells.Fixed(CANDIDATES_COLUMNS),
    93	                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
    94	                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
    95	                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    96	            ) {
    97	                itemsIndexed(candidates) { _, candidate ->
    98	                    val isUsed = candidate.text in usedTexts
    99	                    Button(
   100	                        onClick = { if (!isUsed) onCandidateSelected(candidate.id) },
   101	                        enabled = !isUsed,
   102	                        modifier = Modifier.alpha(if (isUsed) CONSUMED_ALPHA else 1f),
   103	                        colors =
   104	                            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
   105	                                containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondaryContainer,
   106	                                contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSecondaryContainer,
   107	                            ),
   108	                    ) {
   109	                        Text(text = candidate.text)
   110	                    }
   111	                }
   112	            }
   113	        }
   114	        Button(
   115	            onClick = onSubmit,
   116	            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
   117	        ) {
   118	            Text("Готово")
   119	        }
   120	    }
   121	}

**Findings**

1. **HIGH [Realist] Last-question `onStop` can save an attempt during rotation/process kill.**  
AC-35/36 require rotation to preserve the active attempt and process kill to write nothing ([0-spec.md](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/docs/features/lesson-runner/0-spec.md:1084)). But `doOnStop` always calls `handlePause()` ([DefaultLessonRunnerRootComponent.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/android/feature/lesson-runner/presentation/src/main/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/android/feature/lesson_runner/presentation/component/DefaultLessonRunnerRootComponent.kt:72)), and if auto-answering advances past the final question it launches `triggerComplete()` ([DefaultLessonRunnerRootComponent.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/android/feature/lesson-runner/presentation/src/main/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/android/feature/lesson_runner/presentation/component/DefaultLessonRunnerRootComponent.kt:211)), which persists via `CompleteAttemptUseCase` ([CompleteAttemptUseCase.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/shared/feature/lesson-runner/domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/shared/feature/lesson_runner/domain/use_case/CompleteAttemptUseCase.kt:43)). A user rotating or process-killing on the last question can get an unintended saved attempt.

2. **HIGH [Architect] Rating submission discards the rating payload.**  
The domain builds a full `LessonRating` with `id`, `lessonVersion`, `rating`, and `ratedAt` ([SubmitLessonRatingUseCase.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/shared/feature/lesson-runner/domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/shared/feature/lesson_runner/domain/use_case/SubmitLessonRatingUseCase.kt:40)), but the data mapper persists only `(userId, lessonId, submittedAt)` ([LessonRatingMapper.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/shared/feature/lesson-runner/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/shared/feature/lesson_runner/data/mapper/LessonRatingMapper.kt:6)) into a local “submitted” flag table ([LessonRatingSubmittedLocalEntity.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/shared/core/persistence/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/shared/core/persistence/LessonRatingSubmittedLocalEntity.kt:10)). So the UI can hide the prompt as “submitted” while the actual rating value/version are lost and cannot be synced later.

3. **MEDIUM [Skeptic] Fresh anonymous-auth startup can fail the first lesson tap.**  
`AppApplication` starts anonymous sign-in but does not await it ([AppApplication.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/apps/android-next/src/main/java/com/tpov/schoolquiz/apps/android_next/AppApplication.kt:79)). `AuthRepository.currentUid()` returns the first auth-flow emission ([AuthRepositoryImpl.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/shared/feature/app-shell/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/shared/feature/app_shell/data/AuthRepositoryImpl.kt:25)), and `StartLessonAttemptUseCase` immediately fails on `null` ([StartLessonAttemptUseCase.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/shared/feature/lesson-runner/domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/shared/feature/lesson_runner/domain/use_case/StartLessonAttemptUseCase.kt:37)). On a fresh install, a quick lesson tap can show `AuthRequired` instead of the first question.

4. **MEDIUM [Skeptic] System Back is a no-op on result/init-failed runner states.**  
Parent back handling always routes active lesson-runner back to `onCrossButtonTap()` ([DefaultQuizzesComponent.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/android/feature/quizzes-screen/presentation/src/main/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/android/feature/quizzes_screen/presentation/component/DefaultQuizzesComponent.kt:71)), but `onCrossButtonTap()` only handles `RunnerUiState.Question` ([DefaultLessonRunnerRootComponent.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/android/feature/lesson-runner/presentation/src/main/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/android/feature/lesson_runner/presentation/component/DefaultLessonRunnerRootComponent.kt:153)). On result or empty/error screens, hardware Back does nothing even though the screen has a navigation-back path.

5. **LOW [Realist] Timer UI coverage is claimed but one timer test remains ignored.**  
AC-62 requires Compose UI tests for timer behavior ([0-spec.md](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/docs/features/lesson-runner/0-spec.md:1144)), but `ct10_timer_expired_onTimeout_invoked` is still `@Ignore` ([LessonRunnerScreenTest.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/android/feature/lesson-runner/presentation/src/androidTest/kotlin/com/tpov/schoolquiz/android/feature/lesson_runner/presentation/LessonRunnerScreenTest.kt:173)). The production code may now call `onTimeout`, but the acceptance coverage claim is not true until this test is enabled or replaced.

Checked ADR-specific items: the DI chain is registered in the requested order in `AppApplication` ([AppApplication.kt](/home/Programming/Android/schoolquiz4.0/apps/android-next/src/main/java/com/tpov/schoolquiz/apps/android_next/AppApplication.kt:125)); `lessonRunnerDomainKoinAdapter` is in `data/androidMain`; root/factory live in lesson-runner presentation; reverse lesson-runner → quizzes-screen imports were clean; `DifficultyConverter` production code is absent; and `RunnerUiState.Result` is flat, with no `Attempt`/PII aggregate.
